messages:
cam: Filing a small DX bug we hit in the Next Edge + LlamaIndex starter. Streaming summaries from the edge function sometimes stop after ~1m and the page just spins.
yuki: edge or serverless? any console logs?
cam: Edge runtime (middleware/Edge API route) using fetch() to /v1/stream. Repro on local dev with ngrok and in Vercel preview. Behavior: we start streaming, see a few tokens in the SSE, then status 401 shows up in the fetch stream, the client retries and we quickly hit 429s. UI shows spinner, no clear message.
rahul: does the starter use ephemeral tokens in edge env? those TTLs + keepalive issues can bite edge clients because you can't easily refresh credentials in-flight.
cam: yes the starter README suggests using DEMO_EPHEMERAL token for quick demos. For edge routes that's not ideal.
yuki: aha. Two dimensions here: 1) SDK should avoid blind retries on 401 for in-flight SSE/fetch streams (parity with JS fix), 2) the Next Edge starter should surface preflight guidance: use a longer-lived dev token for edge previews or wire server-side token refresh (token proxy) pattern.
cam: minimal repro snippet (server component):
```js
// pages/api/summary-edge.js (Edge)
export default async function handler(req) {
  const res = await fetch("https://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream", {
    method: "POST",
    headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${process.env.DEMO_EPHEMERAL}` },
    keepalive: true
  });
  return new Response(res.body, { headers: { 'Content-Type': 'text/event-stream' } });
}
```
cam: logs: 
```
[2025-10-02T09:44:10Z] POST /v1/stream 200 stream-start
[2025-10-02T09:45:15Z] STREAM ERROR: 401 token expired
[2025-10-02T09:45:15Z] SDK RETRY attempt=1 after 401
[2025-10-02T09:45:16Z] POST /v1/stream 429 Too Many Requests
```
rahul: edge fetch keepalive + retry storms is rough. For SSR/edge starters we recommend either: a) server-side token proxy with refresh (longer TTL tokens kept in server env), or b) use REDWOOD_DEV_TOKEN for previews. Also update starter to detect edge runtime and print a warning if token TTL < 300s.
yuki: SDK note: JS SDK already has a guard which treats 401 mid-stream as terminal. Python parity tracked elsewhere, but we need the edge/SSG sample to be explicit.
cam: opened PR with quick fixes: https://github.com/redwood-inference/devex-starters/pull/778 - adds edge-specific README section, a dev token suggestion, and a small middleware snippet that proxies token refresh. Also added a runtime TTL check in the starter: if process.env.DEMO_EPHEMERAL TTL < 300 show console.warn and abort streaming call with a user-facing message.
preview-bot: Preview for pr-778 available: https://preview.redwood.dev/devex-starters/pr-778 :rocket:
rahul: can we also add an eval harness in eng-ml that simulates edge streaming + forced 401 at t=65s and asserts the client surfaces AuthExpiredError rather than retry loops? That'll catch regressions.
yuki: yes I'll add an eval test and a small unit test for the SDK's stream retry policy. Also adding telemetry event `edge_stream_auth_abort`.
cam: tested PR locally with ngrok and a 90s stream, preview now shows a clear "Token expired during stream — refresh or use a longer-lived dev token" message instead of spinner. UX much better.
rahul: great. Longer-term: update templates to include optional token-proxy helper and a one-click script to mint a dev token with TTL=24h for local dev.
yuki: assigning SDK follow-up: ISSUE-778 to ensure parity and add configuration to opt into retries for server-side scenarios.
cam: thanks team — will add a short blurb in the workshop notes so attendees don't hit this during demos. :thumbsup:
